narratives.Description: Wave 2 of epic #2948. Implement R1 slash-command intent containment, R2 typed hotfixCriteria classifier, R3 requireHumanMerge human merge gate. Do not absorb UAT/provenance (#2944 Wave 1, already shipped). Parent program #2948.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want slash-command sessions and merge/hotfix policy enforced as typed intent ceilings, so that unattended agents cannot escalate a weak verb into a prod deploy.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Add plan.policy.hotfixCriteria and plan.policy.requireHumanMerge typed fields (packages/types policy + schema; read-time narrative deprecation like #746). Step 2 R1: extend #810 intent gate for slash-command provenance (session inherits command verb; non-implement verbs cannot authorize implement/push/PR/merge/deploy); AGENTS/agents-entry + TS preflight (not dead Python path if already ported). Step 3 R2: evaluateHotfixEligibility pure function + tests for eligibility table (small fix, revert OK; large surface/refactor/forbidden path never). Agent may label hotfix-candidate only; human promotes hotfix. Step 4 R3: three-surface requireHumanMerge (merge preflight refuse agent merge; verify:branch aggregate; branch-protection/setup notes); session-start disclosure; policy:allow-bot-merge --confirm + DEFT_ALLOW_BOT_MERGE=1. Step 5: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #1193/#2948. Verification: unit tests for classifier + merge gate + intent; task check:merge when green. drive-to: merge-ready.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a PROJECT-DEFINITION policy object, loaders return typed hotfixCriteria and requireHumanMerge and validate their shapes.
When a session inherits a non-implement slash verb, the intent gate blocks implement push PR merge and deploy tool authorization.
evaluateHotfixEligibility returns eligible only for small-fix and pure-revert cases and rejects refactor large-surface and forbidden-path diffs.

items.title: R3 human merge gate three-surface enforcement

narrative.Acceptance: When requireHumanMerge is true, agent-initiated merge fails closed and session-start emits the human-merge disclosure line.
Given the eligibility fixture table, unit tests returns green for each row and CHANGELOG Unreleased records #1193 under Added.
